review.schemeScope: Combined Ordinary scheme (16 pages). PDF 1 cover; 2 blank; 3 title page; 4 general marking instruction (red ink, major errors underlined) and the listening tariffs for Cuid A and B (3 marc × 4 for each extract); 5 the Cuid C tariffs (3 marc × 2 for each piece; its Cuid C line misprints the part’s total as “20 marc (Eolas)” above “6 + 6+ = 12 mharc”), the 0–6 language deduction, and the start of the recording’s script; 5–8 the script (Fógra 1 to Píosa 2) and no answer key; 8 composition marking (headed “CEIST 2 - CEAPADÓIREACHT - 120 MARC”, a misprint: the paper prints 100 and the tariffs add to 100); 9–13 Paper 2; 14 Socruithe Réasúnta (reasonable accommodations: spelling and certain grammar features not counted; no bands); 15–16 empty.

nonPoolDecisions: The 2012 scheme prints no listening answer key: only each section’s tariff (3 marks a question), the 0–6 language deduction and the recording’s script. Every printed question is still carded (every printed ask gets a card): its own criterion at 3, its guidance the question as the paper prints it and the section’s printed tariff line, claimed whole (0 or 3; no partial is printed). The card says “The scheme prints no answer for this part.” Nothing is lifted from the script as an answer: choosing the sentence that answers a question would be writing a key the SEC never printed.

Card unit for listening: six segment cards, because the Bank plays one recording section as one exercise; every printed question is a separate criterion (20 questions at 3, the four Fógra a hAon grid questions included; 60 marks). Separate question cards are not added: they would repeat the same prompts inside that exercise.

Composition: “Freagair do rogha dhá cheann de A, B, C, D anseo.” Each printed title (A three, B C D two each: 9) is one 50-mark card (Tasc 2, Ábhar 8, Cumas Gaeilge 40) carrying the instruction as a task check; no combination cards. Tasc is printed whole (0/2); Ábhar and Cumas Gaeilge are judged on the scheme’s printed aspects.
The letter or email (C), dó/di, and “ó bhéal nó ar líne” (D(i)) are flexible forms inside one response, not routes.

caveats: Paper 1 = 160: listening 60 (Cuid A 24 = Fógra 1 12 + Fógra 2 12; Cuid B 24 = Comhrá 1 12 + Comhrá 2 12; Cuid C 12 = Píosa 1 6 + Píosa 2 6) and composition 100 (any two of A–D at 50: Tasc 2, Ábhar 8, Cumas Gaeilge 40).
No listening answer key: scheme PDF 4–5 print the tariffs and PDF 5–8 the script; the builder asserts that no printed listening question of the paper appears anywhere in the scheme.
Listening language: “Bainfear ó 0 go 6 ar chaighdeán na Gaeilge .” (PDF 5) is one section-level deduction; cards state it without applying it.

Scheme misprints kept as printed and not used for marks: PDF 5’s Cuid C line reads “20 marc (Eolas)” above “6 + 6+ = 12 mharc” (its two pieces print 3 marc × 2 = 6 each); PDF 8 heads the composition “120 MARC” (the paper prints 100 MARC and the tariffs add to 100); the examiner’s Nóta reads “(Tásc)” for Tasc.
Paper misprints kept as printed: Píosa a hAon 2 “Cathain a fhillleann an t-údar ar Thoraí?” (for “fhilleann”); B(i) “Léim mo chroi” (for “chroí”).

Socruithe Réasúnta (PDF 14): for candidates granted reasonable accommodations, every part of the scheme applies except spelling and certain grammar features; it prints no bands, and the composition cards say so in English.
review.choicePolicy: Choice is not a route: each printed composition title is one card carrying the printed choose-two instruction; no combination cards.
review.boundaries: 6 listening segment cards carrying all 20 printed questions as separate criteria, each at 3 (60; the scheme prints no answer key); 9 composition titles at 50 (answer any two; no combination cards).

cards.questionText:
Treoracha d’iarrthóirí
Ní mór do na hiarrthóirí cúram a dhéanamh de chruinneas na teanga. Caillfear marcanna má bhítear faillitheach ann. Ní mór ceangal cinnte leanúnach a bheith ann idir an teideal a roghnaítear agus an t-ábhar a scríobhtar.

Freagair do rogha dhá cheann de A, B, C, D anseo. Ní mór leathleathanach nó mar sin a scríobh sa dá fhreagra.

A · GIOTA LEANÚNACH / BLAG (50 marc)
Scríobh giota leanúnach nó blag ar cheann amháin de na hábhair seo.
(i) Mo laethanta ar scoil.
taskRequirements: Freagair do rogha dhá cheann de A, B, C, D anseo.
Write in the form the question asks for.
Ní mór ceangal cinnte leanúnach a bheith ann idir an teideal a roghnaítear agus an t-ábhar a scríobhtar.
Leathleathanach nó mar sin.

criteria.label: An Tasc
guidance: Freagair do rogha dhá cheann de A, B, C, D anseo. I gcás A, B, C, agus D (Dhá cheann le freagairt) Leathleathanach nó breis: Tasc = 2 mharc Ábhar = 8 marc = 50 marc × 2 Cumas Gaeilge = 40 marc = 100 marc

criteria.label: An tÁbhar
guidance: [Gearrfar pionós ar iarrthóirí mura mbeidh na hiarrachtaí ceapadóireachta ad rem.]

criteria.label: An Cumas Gaeilge
guidance: [Cumas Gaeilge = (i) fairsinge agus saibhreas Stór Gaeilge an iarrthóra (= 40%) móide (ii) beachtas maidir le máistreacht cruinnúsáide ar na príomhghnéithe de cheart na Gaeilge (= 50%) agus litriú (= 10%).]

Nóta: Caithfidh an Scrúdaitheoir an marc a bhronntar as 2 (Tásc), an marc a bhronntar as 8 (Ábhar) agus an marc a bhronntar as 40 (Gaeilge) a thaispeáint go soiléir ag bun na n-iarrachtaí ceapadóireachta.

cards.markingGuideNote: Whole 50-mark composition: Tasc 2, Ábhar 8, Cumas Gaeilge 40. The 2012 scheme prints no 40-mark table: Cumas Gaeilge is judged on its printed aspects, (i) the range and richness of the candidate’s Irish (40%) and (ii) accuracy in the main features of correct Irish (50%) and spelling (10%), so the award can take any value from 0 to 40. Socruithe Réasúnta (scheme PDF 14): for candidates granted reasonable accommodations, spelling and certain grammar features are not counted; the scheme prints no bands for it. The letter or email (C) and the dó/di wording are flexible forms inside one response, not separate routes.
